subject: Obstruction - Northumberland Strait
text:
Obstruction - Northumberland Strait
Two rowing course established in Hillsborough River, PEI.
1: A 250 meter buoyed rowing course consisting of four yellow buoys located in the area of 46 13.684N 063 08.939W.
2: A 1,000 meter buoyed rowing course consisting of five yellow buoys located in the area of 46 13.632N 063 08.097W. 
Caution.
